metadata.bank_name: Coding Topics Practice — 24 Topic Question Bank
metadata.io_contract: Each input is a JSON object; each expected output is a JSON value. Programs should read one JSON object and output one JSON value, or site can invoke typed function adapter.
metadata.note: Ten representative tests can cover important boundaries, but cannot mathematically exhaust all possible inputs in a nontrivial domain.

questions.title: Integer to Decimal String
questions.problem_statement: Convert the integer value to its signed decimal string representation.
questions.input_format: A single JSON object: {"value": integer}.
questions.output_format: Print/return a single valid JSON value matching the requested result; array order matters unless stated otherwise.
questions.constraints: -256 ≤ value ≤ 256; all computations use exact integer arithmetic unless conversion explicitly requested.

examples.explanation: Start from value=7. Convert the integer value to its signed decimal string representation. Therefore the expected JSON output is "7".
Start from value=0. Convert the integer value to its signed decimal string representation. Therefore the expected JSON output is "0".
Start from value=12. Convert the integer value to its signed decimal string representation. Therefore the expected JSON output is "12".
